At the Antonio Circosta Law Firm, International Law is at the very heart of our practice. We support companies, institutions and individuals who operate across borders, providing legal services that connect local realities with global strategies.

Cross-Border Contracts and International Disputes

Our expertise covers cross-border contracts, where we assist clients in drafting, negotiating and enforcing agreements that must comply with multiple legal systems.

We also represent clients in international disputes, whether before foreign courts or arbitral tribunals, ensuring effective protection in complex litigation scenarios.

International Arbitration

Our Firm places great emphasis on international arbitration, offering a structured, fast and reliable path to resolving disputes outside traditional courts. Arbitration allows businesses to safeguard their interests while maintaining confidentiality and efficiency, and is an increasingly popular choice for companies.

Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms

Our commitment to human rights and fundamental freedoms forms a distinctive part of our international work. We represent individuals and organisations before national and supranational courts, combining legal strategy with a deep respect for the universal values of justice.

An International Network

With a strong international presence and trusted partners in Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa and the Middle East, we ensure our clients can count on a legal partner that understands the complexities of today's globalised world.
